verdict.rationale: Deepgram documents temporary, time-limited tokens (30s TTL) explicitly positioned as more secure than long-lived API keys for real-time use, which supports a least-privilege credential model. However, there is no evidence of granular scoping (e.g., restricting a token to specific capabilities, projects, or actions) beyond time-limitation. Missing for 10: documented permission/scope granularity for tokens, role-based restrictions, or agent-specific credential scoping beyond TTL.
